## Deck Goal
Teach Year-2 physics students to turn one familiar vertical-motion calculation into an ordered algorithm, trace a MATLAB for-loop, make one bounded parameter change, diagnose clear defects from evidence, and explain what validation does and does not prove.

## Required Background
{
  "deck_context": {
    "deck_context": "Week 02 reuses the familiar one-dimensional vertical-launch model so the new cognitive load is algorithmic rather than mathematical. The lecture moves from prediction to one calculation, then to a repeatable recipe, index mapping, two-pass tracing, a MATLAB loop, bounded completion, controlled modification, plotted evidence, defect classification, validation limits, and transfer.",
    "core_claim": "A loop becomes trustworthy when every pass has a clear input, current value, update, matching output slot, stopping point, check, and physical interpretation.",
    "locked_model": "y(t) = y0 + v0 t - (1/2) g t^2; upward is positive; air resistance is neglected; gravity is constant; y0_m = 0 m; v0_mps = 20 m s^-1; g_mps2 = 9.81 m s^-2; t_s = 0:0.5:4 s.",
    "exactness": "Equations, code, indices, numerical values, units, signs, assertions, and plot data are strict teaching content. Do not invent, paraphrase, or approximate them.",
    "canonical_terms": [
      "physical prediction",
      "input / calculate / store / check",
      "pseudocode",
      "start / current / update / next / stop",
      "sample_index",
      "current_time_s",
      "for loop",
      "syntax defect",
      "indexing or operator defect",
      "physical or logical defect",
      "known-value validation",
      "physical interpretation"
    ],
    "course_alignment": {
      "core": [
        "decompose into input, calculation, output, and check",
        "plain-language pseudocode",
        "loop start/current/update/next/stopping point",
        "trace first two iterations",
        "complete one scaffold line",
        "modify one parameter and predict effect",
        "diagnose three clear defect types",
        "use known-value and physical checks",
        "interpret the graph physically"
      ],
      "working_exposure": [
        "preallocation",
        "supplied MATLAB comparison plot"
      ],
      "stretch": [
        "write a reusable function from scratch",
        "design a second independent test"
      ],
      "removed": [
        "eigenproblems",
        "normal modes",
        "advanced root-finding stress cases"
      ]
    }
  },
  "slide_local_context": "Use exact short defect fragments and consequences: Syntax: for k = 1:numel(t_s); ...; % missing end -> MATLAB cannot determine the loop boundary. Indexing: y_m(1) = ... inside every loop pass -> code runs but overwrites one storage slot. Physical sign: y_m(k) = y0_m + v0_mps*t_s(k) + 0.5*g_mps2*t_s(k)^2 -> code runs but accelerates upward and contradicts upward-positive gravity. Evidence path: error location / pseudocode / output / physics."
}
